mapper.select: SELECT ao.id AS id, ao.application_id AS applicationId, ao.object_id AS objectId, ao.object_role AS objectRole, ao.sort_order AS sortOrder, ao.options AS options, o.suite_code AS suiteCode, o.object_code AS objectCode, o.object_name AS objectName, o.object_type AS objectType, o.design_status AS designStatus, o.config_key AS configKey, o.status AS objectStatus, c.runtime_datasource_code AS datasourceCode, COALESCE(c.runtime_table_name, c.table_name) AS tableName, c.model_schema AS modelSchema, c.runtime_datasource_snapshot AS runtimeDatasourceSnapshot, c.draft_version AS designVersion, c.layout_type AS layoutType, o.designer_options AS designerOptions, COALESCE(shared_stats.application_count, 0) AS sharedApplicationCount, o.update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_business_application_object ao INNER JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = ao.tenant_id AND o.id = ao.object_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_crud_config c ON c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND c.config_key = o.config_key AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, object_id, COUNT(1) AS application_count FROM ai_business_application_object WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY tenant_id, object_id ) shared_stats ON shared_stats.tenant_id = ao.tenant_id AND shared_stats.object_id = ao.object_id WHERE ao.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ao.application_id = #{applicationId} AND ao.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY CASE ao.object_role WHEN 'PRIMARY' THEN 1 WHEN 'DETAIL' THEN 2 WHEN 'REFERENCE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, ao.sort_order ASC, ao.id ASC

SELECT ao.application_id FROM ai_business_application_object ao INNER JOIN ai_business_application a ON a.tenant_id = ao.tenant_id AND a.id = ao.application_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE ao.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ao.object_id = #{objectId} AND ao.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY ao.application_id ASC
